name: TianYu Bio-Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: TianYu Eco-Environment Co., Ltd. operates extensively within China, specializing in comprehensive water resource management. Its diverse activities span environmental improvement initiatives for rural areas and small towns, creation of ecological gardens, remediation of soil and mining sites, solid waste processing, municipal infrastructure support, and the development of water conservation facilities. The company also ventures into the tourism sector, providing services such as planning and design, project construction and operation, resource revitalization, investment in destinations, and the innovation of cultural and creative merchandise. Additionally, it is involved in agribusiness, forestry, and park development. Founded in 2000 and based in Shanghai, China, the company rebranded as TianYu Eco-Environment Co., Ltd. in November 2017, having previously operated under the name Tianyu Ecology & Landscape Co.,Ltd.
